meaning: A customer's request for a quotation, from a matched inbound message or opened by a person; groups the message, the quotation agent's drafts, the approval and follow-up items and the resulting documents (ADR-0066 rule 3).
A customer's complaint or issue and everything done about it: interactions, credit or debit notes, returns and follow-ups (ADR-0066 rule 3; ADR-0052 rule 20).

A supplier invoice arriving by mailbox or upload, with its record or extraction, the purchase invoice agent's draft and the review items; resolved by the system when every artifact is final and no linked item is open. Signed XML posted by the auto-post gateway needs none (ADR-0066 rules 3, 4, 15).
A message from an unknown sender that may become a new customer: the onboarding agent's partner and contact proposals and their approval (ADR-0066 rule 3; ADR-0051 rule 11).
A supplier, internal or customer nonconformance with its inspection lot, containment and corrective action items, returns, scrap and rework documents (ADR-0070 rule 16; ADR-0066 rule 3).

A blocked WO and what was done about it: its stop logs, work items, change orders, issues and confirmations; opened by people, or by the operation_blocked raise when work_case.production_disruption.mode is auto (ADR-0071 rule 18; ADR-0066 rule 3).

A suspected or confirmed personal data breach: assess, contain, record, notify, close; opened by a person, attaching a personal_data_incident_suspected item or directly, with no origin (open key: the case's own ID, so several breaches may be open at once); its personal_data_breach row holds what an authority asks for, and it cannot be resolved while the notification fields a package rule requires are empty (ADR-0079 rule 16).
